The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas in the statistics section, resulting in #NAME? errors.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical statistics. This indicates that the formulas used for the 'statistics' matrix (EXPECTED_STATS) are either referencing undefined names or using functions not recognized by the spreadsheet engine. Other matrices like EXPECTED_NET passed, suggesting the core workbook structure is correct but the statistical derivation logic is broken.
